  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotency
  outputs:
    proceed: normalizeAddress
    replay: replayOwner

replayOwner:

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress

  next: checkCityCapacity

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkDailyLimit

checkDailyLimit:

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: checkIdentityUnique

# Duplicate check: rejects a full identityKey (SHA-256 over telephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName))
# match. This single identity key is the only 409 ground; the old separate household-duplicate block
# no longer applies. Before save so the new owner is matched only against existing owners.
checkIdentityUnique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft-match: only reached when not a hard duplicate. A declared household member
# (sharesHousehold) is never flagged; otherwise a soundex(lastName)+postcode match with a
# differing identityKey is still created but flagged possibleDuplicate with the match id.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:

  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipNumber

assignMembershipNumber:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipNumber
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# Household level ceiling: a new owner's membershipLevel cannot exceed one above the current
# maximum among their existing household members. Runs after the householdId is assigned and
# before save, so the new owner is capped against existing owners only.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevelCap
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Pairs the request's Idempotency-Key (if any) with the just-saved owner id, so a repeat replays it.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: bulkSignupWarning

bulkSignupWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignBulkSignupWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: householdMemberCount

householdMemberCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdMemberCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title. When present it is one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR and is used to compose the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and
            'address' is returned as the composed, normalized string (addressLine1, plus a single
            space and addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present; normalized the same way (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address. When present it is
            normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four digits and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall
            within that region's range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present it
            is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand' relative to the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-05-14'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household (same last name and postcode) with an existing owner. The
            householdId is computed regardless; this flag only bypasses the household
            duplicate block, so a matching owner is created as a declared household
            member instead of being rejected with 409 (and is not flagged a possible
            duplicate). The full-identity duplicate check still applies.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title followed by a single space and the
                lastName when a title is present, otherwise just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR who'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space,
                then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the
                region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city-to-region table)
                and HASH8 is the first eight upper-cased hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the lastName. Assigned at creation;
                there is no per-city sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over '<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>'. Computed for every owner,
                so any two owners with the same last name and postcode automatically
                carry the same value and belong to the same household.
              type: string
              example: '1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
